story: Chattahoochee Bend State Park is located in Coweta County, Georgia, and covers 2,910 acres of forest along a bend in the Chattahoochee River. It is one of the state's largest state parks and opened to the public on July 1, 2011.
matters: The park provides a natural habitat for wildlife including black bears, white-tailed deer, and various bird species across its forest ecosystem in Georgia, USA.
name: Chattahoochee Bend State Park
